objective: Close the M143 independent-review row-order, sequence-identity, outer-barrier, and zero-work endpoint gaps with a thin wrapper around the sealed M142 controller.
required_properties: each accepted job contains exactly row_window_rows consecutive relative row IDs starting at zero
each allocated bank carries a 32-bit sequence echoed at PWP and correction launch and completion
correction completions retire in global sequence order
post-fence PWP and correction launches remain blocked until the matching external commit acknowledgement
producer lookahead may fill the remaining finite banks while a barrier is active
barrier commit is offered only after every sequence at or below the fence completes correction
PWP, correction, and commit payloads remain stable under backpressure
zero-work jobs still traverse PWP and correction endpoints with at least one modeled service cycle
malformed relative row identity, wrong completion sequence, and unsolicited commit acknowledgement fail closed
required_nonzero_covers: all four banks owned during active barrier
post-fence sequence blocked then external commit offered
external commit followed by post-fence PWP launch
